name: malformed
description: One malformed record must cost itself, never the run. Device 9601 carries a bare string and a null inside ip_addresses and a string inside mac_addresses -- the unguarded .get on those entries used to abort the task, losing the current page and every page after it. Device 9602 carries present-but-null macAddresses/ip_addresses fields, which the old `.get(key, [])` defaults did not defend (a .get default only applies when the key is ABSENT), so `None + []` aborted the run. The bare string in the Devices array itself has no id to key on and is counted with the id-less devices. All three real devices must import with whatever addressing was usable. namespaced_ids is skipped for the reason recorded in happy. NOTE: the served page size is learned from the first response (so a server-side row cap cannot silently truncate the import), which means a single-page inventory is confirmed with one extra request that must return an empty Devices array.

log_contains: device42: skipped 1 devices with no stable id
